extraction.Name: Martha Bettelyoun Hill
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want to accept her patent in fee but did so simply for the reason that she was asked to do so by the Superintendent, and did not want to appear in the attitude of a kicker
extraction.Recorded patent: does not remember whether or not she had the patent recorded in the County seat
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: her land was sold, but was not mortgaged before the sale
extraction.Buyer: Nile Dunbar of Cody, Nebraska, who made the payment and took the land; received $2600.00 for it
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: the land was not sold for debts or taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: she and her family are supported by her husband who does general work, mostly working at the carpenter trade
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in good health; family is also in good health; has five children depending on herself and husband for support; states she was not defrauded of her land and while she did not get what it was worth, she made a fair and square deal; did not consider $2600.00 a good price but it was the best she could get at that time; document signed with an X mark
